// comment: Maps env-var name -> vault key. Loaded by ../hadoku_site/scripts/secrets/dev-vault.mjs and read by services/pm2/privatebin-wrapper.mjs in hadoku_site. Values fetched at runtime, never committed. No tier key arrays: the shim trusts edge-router for tier resolution (it forwards X-User-Key/X-User-Id untouched, and verifies provenance via EDGE_AUTH_SECRET). `key-generate --repo ../hadoku-privatebin` grants this repo's service key ACL rows for exactly these keys.
// HADOKU_NPM_READ_TOKEN: Declared so this repo's service key is granted it: CI reads the registry token from the vault via hadoku-actions/setup-pnpm vault-key.
// no EDGE_AUTH_SECRET: Deliberately absent. It is edge-router's provenance secret: whoever holds it can claim any tier to any backend. Production's PM2 wrapper fetches it under its own principal; a service key (and so dev-vault) never holds it (hadoku_site, 2026-10-31). Local dev: INSECURE_NO_EDGE_AUTH=1 trusts identity headers unverified (bare local only).
